Version=1.0.2
=============
1) Replace the variable "knots" by the variable "knot" everywhere to avoid confusion with knots() R build-in function
2) change notation paradigm:
variable "knot" refers to knots including ends (replace int_knots in version 1.0.1)
variable "ext_knot" refers to extended knot partition (replace knots in version 1.0.1)
